---
title: "North Carolina 2026 General Election Explorer"
toc: false
---

Explore official precinct-tabulated results from the **November 3, 2026** North Carolina general election across all 100 counties. Use the **top-right map control** to switch races or toggle county vote-volume bubbles, and hover over any county for a full breakdown.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Read NCSBE 2026 precinct file once
raw_results <- read_tsv(
  unz("data/results_pct_20261103.zip", "results_pct_20261103.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Summarize DEM vs REP votes, voting methods, and margin by county
summarize_race <- \(df, prefix) {
  df |>
    summarize(
      dem = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "DEM"], na.rm = TRUE),
      rep = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "REP"], na.rm = TRUE),
      total = sum(`Total Votes`, na.rm = TRUE),
      early = sum(`Early Voting`, na.rm = TRUE),
      eday = sum(`Election Day`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = County
    ) |>
    mutate(
      dem_pct = dem / total * 100,
      rep_pct = rep / total * 100,
      margin = dem_pct - rep_pct
    ) |>
    rename_with(\(col) paste0(prefix, "_", col), -County)
}

# Summarize three major 2026 contests across all 100 counties
senate <- raw_results |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  summarize_race("sen")

scourt <- raw_results |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "NC SUPREME COURT ASSOCIATE JUSTICE SEAT 01") |>
  summarize_race("sc")

uhouse <- raw_results |>
  filter(str_starts(`Contest Name`, "US HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES")) |>
  summarize_race("uh")

# Join race summaries to NC county shapes (converted to WGS84 for leaflet)
nc_map <- counties(state = "NC", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(County = str_to_upper(NAME)) |>
  left_join(senate, by = "County") |>
  left_join(scourt, by = "County") |>
  left_join(uhouse, by = "County") |>
  mutate(
    early_share = sen_early / sen_total * 100,
    # Build a rich HTML hover card showing all 3 races + voting method
    tooltip_html = paste0(
      "<div style='font-family:system-ui; min-width:230px;'>",
      "<div style='font-size:15px; font-weight:700; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd; padding-bottom:4px; margin-bottom:6px;'>",
      NAME, " County</div>",
      "<b>U.S. Senate:</b> Cooper ", sprintf("%.1f%%", sen_dem_pct),
      " vs. Whatley ", sprintf("%.1f%%", sen_rep_pct), "<br/>",
      "<b>NC Supreme Ct:</b> Earls ", sprintf("%.1f%%", sc_dem_pct),
      " vs. Stevens ", sprintf("%.1f%%", sc_rep_pct), "<br/>",
      "<b>U.S. House (all dist.):</b> DEM ", sprintf("%.1f%%", uh_dem_pct),
      " vs. REP ", sprintf("%.1f%%", uh_rep_pct), "<hr style='margin:6px 0;'/>",
      "<b>Total Ballots (Senate):</b> ", scales::comma(sen_total), "<br/>",
      "<b>Early Voting Share:</b> ", sprintf("%.1f%%", early_share),
      "</div>"
    ) |>
      map(htmltools::HTML)
  )

# Compute county center coordinates for the optional vote-volume bubble layer
centers <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(nc_map)))
nc_map <- nc_map |>
  mutate(lng = centers[, 1], lat = centers[, 2])

# Statewide totals for top summary cards
sw_sen_dem <- sum(nc_map$sen_dem) / sum(nc_map$sen_total) * 100
sw_sc_dem  <- sum(nc_map$sc_dem) / sum(nc_map$sc_total) * 100
sw_uh_dem  <- sum(nc_map$uh_dem) / sum(nc_map$uh_total) * 100
sw_total   <- sum(nc_map$sen_total)
sw_early   <- sum(nc_map$sen_early) / sw_total * 100
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  "<div class='stat-grid'>",
  "<div class='stat-card'><div class='stat-label'>U.S. Senate Winner</div>",
  "<div class='stat-value'>Roy Cooper (D)</div>",
  "<div class='stat-sub'>", sprintf("%.1f%%", sw_sen_dem), " statewide (",
  scales::comma(sum(nc_map$sen_dem)), " votes)</div></div>",

  "<div class='stat-card'><div class='stat-label'>NC Supreme Court Seat 1</div>",
  "<div class='stat-value'>Anita Earls (D)</div>",
  "<div class='stat-sub'>", sprintf("%.1f%%", sw_sc_dem), " statewide (",
  scales::comma(sum(nc_map$sc_dem)), " votes)</div></div>",

  "<div class='stat-card'><div class='stat-label'>U.S. House Statewide Vote</div>",
  "<div class='stat-value'>DEM ", sprintf("%.1f%%", sw_uh_dem), "</div>",
  "<div class='stat-sub'>Across all 14 NC congressional districts</div></div>",

  "<div class='stat-card turnout'><div class='stat-label'>Total Votes & Early Voting</div>",
  "<div class='stat-value'>", scales::comma(sw_total), "</div>",
  "<div class='stat-sub'>", sprintf("%.1f%%", sw_early), " cast via Early Voting</div></div>",
  "</div>"
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Diverging red-white-blue palette centered at 0% margin
max_m <- 65
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#991b1b", "#ef4444", "#f8fafc", "#3b82f6", "#1d4ed8"),
  domain = c(-max_m, max_m),
  na.color = "#6b7280"
)

# Clamp extreme margins slightly so colors stay vivid across counties
clamp_m <- \(x) pmax(pmin(x, max_m), -max_m)

leaflet(nc_map, height = "560px") |>
  addMapPane("labels", zIndex = 450) |>
  # Crisp dark basemap underneath + city labels floating above county colors
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.DarkMatterNoLabels) |>
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$CartoDB.DarkMatterOnlyLabels,
    options = providerTileOptions(pane = "labels")
  ) |>
  # Layer 1: U.S. Senate
  addPolygons(
    group = "U.S. Senate",
    fillColor = ~ pal(clamp_m(sen_margin)),
    fillOpacity = 0.82,
    color = "#1f2937",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~tooltip_html,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2.5, color = "#ffffff", fillOpacity = 0.95, bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  # Layer 2: NC Supreme Court
  addPolygons(
    group = "NC Supreme Court",
    fillColor = ~ pal(clamp_m(sc_margin)),
    fillOpacity = 0.82,
    color = "#1f2937",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~tooltip_html,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2.5, color = "#ffffff", fillOpacity = 0.95, bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  # Layer 3: U.S. House by County
  addPolygons(
    group = "U.S. House",
    fillColor = ~ pal(clamp_m(uh_margin)),
    fillOpacity = 0.82,
    color = "#1f2937",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~tooltip_html,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2.5, color = "#ffffff", fillOpacity = 0.95, bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  # Optional overlay: county vote-volume circles sized by total votes
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng,
    lat = ~lat,
    group = "Vote Volume Bubbles",
    radius = ~ sqrt(sen_total) / 28,
    fillColor = "#fbbf24",
    fillOpacity = 0.45,
    color = "#fde68a",
    weight = 1.2,
    label = ~tooltip_html
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("U.S. Senate", "NC Supreme Court", "U.S. House"),
    overlayGroups = c("Vote Volume Bubbles"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  hideGroup("Vote Volume Bubbles") |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = c(-max_m, max_m),
    title = "Margin (DEM − REP)",
    labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%")
  )
```

### Early Voting vs. Senate Margin

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Interactive scatter plot sized by county vote volume
p <- nc_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(
    Winner = if_else(sen_margin >= 0, "Cooper (DEM)", "Whatley (REP)"),
    hover_txt = paste0(
      NAME, " County\n",
      "Senate Margin: ", sprintf("%+.1f%%", sen_margin), "\n",
      "Early Voting: ", sprintf("%.1f%%", early_share), "\n",
      "Total Votes: ", scales::comma(sen_total)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = early_share,
    y = sen_margin,
    size = sen_total,
    color = Winner,
    text = hover_txt
  )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cooper (DEM)" = "#2563eb", "Whatley (REP)" = "#dc2626")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 16), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Early Voting Share vs. U.S. Senate Margin by County",
    x = "Votes Cast Early (%)",
    y = "Senate Margin (DEM − REP %)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

### Search All 100 Counties

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Searchable, sortable table of all 100 North Carolina counties
nc_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(
    County = NAME,
    `Total Votes` = sen_total,
    `Senate DEM %` = round(sen_dem_pct, 1),
    `Senate REP %` = round(sen_rep_pct, 1),
    `Senate Margin` = round(sen_margin, 1),
    `Supreme Ct DEM %` = round(sc_dem_pct, 1),
    `U.S. House DEM %` = round(uh_dem_pct, 1),
    `Early Vote %` = round(early_share, 1)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(`Total Votes`)) |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  ) |>
  formatCurrency("Total Votes", currency = "", interval = 3, mark = ",", digits = 0)
```
